title: Women : purity of blood and culture
preview:
She is worshipped in the form of stone,
but when made of skin and bone,
Only men are entitled to have hormone.
content:
She is worshipped in the form of stone,
but when made of skin and bone,
Only men are entitled to have hormone.

Worshipped as goddess when the sun is high,
but by dusk, she's just prey under the sky.
The very hands that prayed with pride
now crawl where dignity's denied.
when worshiped, she rides tigers
and then men expects them to be the tiger.
she slays demons with a fiery gaze —
but here, she tiptoes at midnight,
afraid of footsteps louder than hers

They told us —
"You are Devi ,So sacred,So pure,So untouchable"
except when they touch.
Too loud, too expressive, too visible — a shame.
Too shy? Too numb? no movements yet blamed.
(kya bhai sensation nahi hai kya?)

We grew up fitting into frames
We were never photo-sized for
'US' meant to carry purity in our veins,
to cleanse the culture, bear the chains.
Fit in the boundaries of expectation to
"maintain purity of blood and culture"
Heh . this isn't a consequence, it's the cause.
why woman fumble and whisper their words
shape and reshape themselves to adjust
yet Why gaalis are all mother-sister wrapped
Why izzat lies in her skin,but never in his sin.

Well , once you're an ideal,
you're no longer allowed to fail
So Don't call me goddess,
if it means I can't cry.
Don't worship my patience,
And ask me to be shy.
Let me be — flawed and loud,
Not your virtue, not your pride,
not a symbol you decide
Im just a person , let me BE.

title: urges burried
preview:
I won't disturb your steady grace,
Won't beg for room, won't claim a space.
but as a man , would you do the same?
content:
Roots in soil, and fire in skin,
Tangled deep, both caged within.
The earth holds tight, so still, so sound —
But this urge? It shakes the underground.

Soft whispers curl like vines at night,
Fingers of want brushing out of sight.
A plea for touch, a quiet moan,
But silence wraps it — skin to bone.

I won't disturb your steady grace,
Won't beg for room, won't claim a space.
But oh — the pulse that floods my veins,
Like monsoon heat behind windowpanes.

These roots — they hold, they choke, they feed,
But don't they feel this silent need?
To bloom beyond what they were told,
To ache in ways too raw, too bold?

The tree above stands proud and tall,
Bathed in light, admired by all.
But underground, where no eyes pry,
I writhe, I breathe, I wonder why.

Why must my longing stay so tame?
Why does desire come with shame?
Why does this body burn so loud —
Yet taught to hide beneath the shroud?

I'm made of petals, sweat, and storm,
Of hunger dressed in proper form.
Of cracked restraint, of sweet unrest,
Of wanting more, and giving less.

So here I stay — with roots grown deep,
And cravings I don't dare to keep.
Still smiling like I've made my peace…
But darling, this calm? It's just my leash.

title: Oh Gone?
preview:
I was been told it'll hurt less as time passed
But it hurts more, realising that the distance WOULD last
content:
How happy i was, even with the vulnerability of losing you
But this certainty is scratching the core of my heart that I've already lost u
I was been told it'll hurt less as time passed
But it hurts more, realising that the distance WOULD last

This distance, playing the streaks game with me
Sharing 1 snap at a time, as reminder to our existence
And the moments all in past tense
Should i break it or continue?
Should i let the glimpse go or pursue

The story of realizations that hurts & Reality that burns
With each passing day, your absence has become the essence of love
for me, the truth and it's bitterness has spread all through and through
like tea in boiling water, here evaporates the hope and all the wills flee

Giving up the zeal, No complaints no agony, numbness is all i can feel
Probably here starts the journey where even my wounds would heal
Probably "moving on" was not the holy grail…

i still need to experience more of it more of raw emotions ache more of pain MORE OF YOU...
calls never responded feelings never expressed Talks yet to fumble, Eye contacts yet to break Whispers yet to be murmured yearning yet to be composed Outcry yet to be unheard Tears yet to be rubbed unnoticed

title: ended?
preview:
All his versions, with no delay
Would morph them all together
Left with where it all started....
Leading (its way) to where it all ended…
content:
Even when i cried
All i can recall was
Him being absent
When he was with me
All i can recall is me calling him…
Yet him being absent

He tried, surely he must have
Not like he didnt love me
I mean he claimed that he DID
And he promised to change
And made versions of himself

He explained how the newer version is better one
How the new him is based on the last fight
And how he did make efforts of changing himself
All on the basis of my prompts, of what i said

And surely he must have
The changes were all so visible
So much distinguishable
That he made sure i counted them everyday

But then, again, the moment
In every little inconvenience
All his versions, with no delay
Would morph them all together
Left with where it all started….
Leading (its way) to where it all ended…

title: finding...
preview:
if soulmates were to be found
no questions would've been on trust
content:
if love was a finding
i wouldn't have been do lost

if soulmates were to be found
no questions would've been on trust

if forever was not an illusion
we would've been still US

no memories renewed, no past reviewed
I'd still run to you, i have the guts

title: shawty-z
preview:
Bet, Lashes are the curtain
So i hide my desires within
content:
Stop me when you're done
Hold on if its still fun

Kissing u in my dreams
Each blink i see your lips

Bet, Lashes are the curtain
So i hide my desires within

Let my words be the pursuit
Are you still worth the wait?

Met you in your absence
My dreams are still just your ambiance.

Are you actually warm
Or i steeped too much of u in my thoughts

Dig it in, hear me scream
Take it out, I'll lead you to my mouth

Nothing's permanent, so choose this best temporary-sss

title: faking with consent.
preview:
its a facade, with flavours of pain to bear
yet we are here...
content:
How do you do it? relationships i mean
By acting stupid?
Like growing up you do realise its all bullshit
no logic no sense…

half the time you're faking things
starting from stories to choices and preferences
the fake is so good that even warnings starts to sound vague
80% fakes... heh so what? (ours is 20%?)

jox seem overrated, being cringe gets trendy
how it all started, also gets edited involuntarily
in the subconscious, its all v.clear…
"its a facade, with flavours of pain to bear"

no promises feels real, filtered in dreams
expectations so high, judging things in glimpse
Where is it all ending up?
some diaries or notepads, some in insta reels?

are we still playing characters?
mimicking some movie scenes?
whats forcing us into this?
salt and pepper be social media and friends

or is it the story books we read in innocence?
are we stuck? or are we weaving a spider web?
is it the wrong spot? or actions need the change?
what if we stop now?

what confirms things are any better without this?
does getting out of this stop the fight?
or does it just start another one?

title: Hate note.
preview:
dont want to see you die
But see you dead (from inside)
Dont want to see you breathless
But hopeless
content:
I want to witnesses you being dead from inside
Nobody to hold onto but just success…
The chase people did for you
And how you ran to escape
Should be the last thing you regret

I really will the earth and destiny
To make you realize
How important and inaccessible human connections are
And how helpless it feels to not have anyone
to celebrate or to share the happy & sad moments with

I really will to see you cry for someone's presence
like you made people do for you…
I really hope to not see you bloom and be colourful
But dry and dark
Too dead from inside to even see the spark

I dont want to see you die
But see you dead (from inside)
Dont want to see you breathless
But hopeless
Dont want to see you fly
But baseless
Dont want to see you cry
But voiceless
Dont want you see you with closed eyes
But vision less
Dont want to see you raw
But shield less

I need no connections with you anymore
But the connections we had
Is the shit you can't clean for the rest of your life
It's not about getting hurt
It's about breaking down
Scattered and shattered into pieces

I surely would hold me up
Once you drown
I would breathe in relief
Once you suffocate
I would heal
Once you bleed
I would rearrange my pieces
Once you burst

(I have spent 4 new years hoping the best for you
Since 2020 till 2024 i wished the best for you
I loved my extreme and gave you all my heart and soul
And now the vice-versa begins
Just how loyal and constant i was into loving you
Is how great i would be at hating you
Idk if i have unloved you
Probably yes months back but now its the different zone
Congratulations to ur efforts into landing me here
Lets lead this way as per my convenience for the first time may be)
